node.question: Can the edited scene be visually inventoried to locate the paper and candidate receiving object and describe their visible boundaries and occlusions for a narrower insertion investigation?
node.criteria: Pass if visible evidence permits a grounded inventory of the paper and candidate receiving object, including concrete boundaries, visible identifying features, overlap, and visibility limitations. A pass establishes inspectable context only, not confirmed cup identity or insertion. Report separately whether paper identity and cup identity are established, disproved, or unresolved. Fail if adequate visibility positively establishes absence of the paper or any relevant receiving object; identify the decisive evidence. Unknown if framing or visibility prevents even a grounded inventory. Unresolved cup identity must be recorded explicitly and never silently promoted to confirmed identity.
node.binding: Inspect source and edit directly. Use the source only to locate the requested objects and compare appearances, not to certify the reddish object's identity. Describe the paper outline and the reddish object's exposed contour and dark marking; investigate whether these support a cup, another object, or neither determination. Consider the combined visible structure without demanding a visible interior as an absolute identity requirement. Distinguish image-plane overlap from entry into a container. Do not infer hidden geometry or stuffing from the hand's grip.
